easy: A plan for how to reach a goal.

ex.en: Our coach taught us new tactics to win the soccer game.
ex.ko: 코치님은 우리가 경기를 이기도록 새로운 작전을 가르쳐 주셨다.

easy: What a person says in court after promising to tell the truth.

ex.en: The witness told the truth in her testimony.
ex.ko: 그 증인은 자신의 증언에서 진실을 말했다.

easy: Something that shows that a thing is true.

ex.en: Her good grades are testimony to her hard work.
ex.ko: 그녀의 좋은 성적은 열심히 노력했다는 증거이다.

easy: Having to do with the country of Thailand or its people.

ex.en: We ate Thai noodles for dinner.
ex.ko: 우리는 저녁으로 태국 국수를 먹었다.

easy: To make short, high sounds like a small bird.

ex.en: A little bird tweeted outside my window.
ex.ko: 작은 새가 내 창문 밖에서 짹짹거렸다.

easy: Hidden deep down but really there and important.

ex.en: The underlying problem is that we need more sleep.
ex.ko: 근본적인 문제는 우리가 잠이 더 필요하다는 것이다.

easy: Under or below something.

ex.en: The underlying rock was hard and gray.
ex.ko: 그 아래에 있는 바위는 단단하고 회색이었다.

easy: Not right or equal to everyone.

ex.en: It is unfair when one kid gets all the candy.
ex.ko: 한 아이가 사탕을 다 가지면 불공평하다.

easy: Being welcomed and liked as part of a group.

ex.en: The new girl felt acceptance from her classmates.
ex.ko: 새로 온 여자아이는 반 친구들에게 받아들여졌다고 느꼈다.

easy: Once every year.

ex.en: Our family goes to the beach annually.
ex.ko: 우리 가족은 해마다 바닷가에 간다.

easy: The gray powder left after something burns.

ex.en: After the campfire, only gray ash was left.
ex.ko: 캠프파이어가 끝나자 회색 재만 남았다.

easy: A tall tree with strong wood and leaves made of many small leaflets.

ex.en: We sat under a big ash tree.
ex.ko: 우리는 큰 물푸레나무 아래에 앉았다.

easy: Your mom's or dad's sister, or your uncle's wife.

ex.en: My aunt baked cookies with me.
ex.ko: 이모가 나와 함께 쿠키를 구워 주셨다.

easy: To make small round pockets of air in a liquid.

ex.en: The soup bubbled on the stove.
ex.ko: 수프가 스토브 위에서 보글보글 끓었다.

easy: To flow with a soft, splashy sound like a little stream.

ex.en: The little stream bubbled over the rocks.
ex.ko: 작은 시냇물이 바위 위로 졸졸 흘렀다.

easy: To come up to the top in small round pockets of air.

ex.en: Air bubbled up from the bottom of the pond.
ex.ko: 연못 바닥에서 공기 방울이 부글부글 올라왔다.

easy: To tell someone what you think they should do.

ex.en: Our teacher counseled me on how to study.
ex.ko: 선생님은 내게 공부하는 방법을 조언해 주셨다.

easy: Able to cause someone to die.

ex.en: Some mushrooms in the forest are deadly.
ex.ko: 숲에 있는 어떤 버섯들은 치명적이다.

easy: Having poison that can hurt or kill.

ex.en: Stay away from deadly snakes in the grass.
ex.ko: 풀숲에 있는 맹독 뱀을 조심해라.

easy: Wanted very, very much.

ex.en: The desired toy was sold out.
ex.ko: 간절히 원하던 장난감은 다 팔렸다.

easy: A strong wish to keep trying until you do something.

ex.en: With great determination, she finished the race.
ex.ko: 그녀는 강한 의지로 달리기를 끝까지 마쳤다.

easy: Putting your arms around someone to show love.

ex.en: Grandma gave me a warm embrace.
ex.ko: 할머니가 나를 따뜻하게 안아 주셨다.

easy: To show a skill or a feeling so that others can see it.

ex.en: She exhibited great kindness to the new student.
ex.ko: 그녀는 전학생에게 큰 친절을 보였다.

easy: To put things out so that people can look at them.

ex.en: The school exhibited our paintings in the hall.
ex.ko: 학교는 복도에 우리 그림을 전시했다.

easy: A man who is polite and kind to others.

ex.en: The gentleman held the door open for us.
ex.ko: 그 신사는 우리를 위해 문을 잡아 주었다.

easy: A fun night on October 31 when kids wear costumes and get candy.

ex.en: On Halloween, I dressed up as a dinosaur.
ex.ko: 핼러윈에 나는 공룡 옷을 입었다.

easy: A tool with a heavy head that you use to hit nails.

ex.en: Dad used a hammer to put a nail in the wall.
ex.ko: 아빠는 망치로 벽에 못을 박았다.

easy: A small picture on a screen that you click or tap to open something.

ex.en: Tap the game icon to start playing.
ex.ko: 게임 아이콘을 눌러서 게임을 시작해.

easy: Having no end and no limit.

ex.en: The night sky seems infinite.
ex.ko: 밤하늘은 끝이 없어 보인다.

easy: Too many to count.

ex.en: The beach has an infinite number of sand grains.
ex.ko: 해변에는 셀 수 없이 많은 모래알이 있다.

easy: Putting a machine or tool in place so it is ready to use.

ex.en: The installation of the new computer took an hour.
ex.ko: 새 컴퓨터를 설치하는 데 한 시간이 걸렸다.

easy: A person who is from the country of Iran.

ex.en: My classmate is an Iranian who speaks two languages.
ex.ko: 내 반 친구는 두 가지 언어를 말하는 이란 사람이다.

easy: Having to do with the country of Iran or its people.

ex.en: We ate Iranian bread at my friend's house.
ex.ko: 우리는 친구 집에서 이란식 빵을 먹었다.

easy: Hitting something with your foot.

ex.en: Kicking the ball is the best part of soccer.
ex.ko: 공을 차는 것은 축구에서 가장 재미있는 부분이다.

easy: When a hen or other bird makes eggs.

ex.en: The laying of eggs keeps the hens busy in spring.
ex.ko: 봄에는 알을 낳느라 암탉들이 바쁘다.

easy: A very long race where people run for about 26 miles.

ex.en: My uncle ran a marathon and got a medal.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 마라톤을 뛰고 메달을 받았다.

easy: To feel very surprised and happy about something great.

ex.en: We marveled at the huge whale.
ex.ko: 우리는 거대한 고래를 보고 감탄했다.

easy: A person who works in government and helps make rules for a town or country.

ex.en: The politician gave a speech at our school.
ex.ko: 그 정치인이 우리 학교에서 연설을 했다.

easy: Coming first, before the main thing.

ex.en: We did a preliminary test before the real exam.
ex.ko: 우리는 본시험 전에 예비 시험을 봤다.

easy: To be shown to the public for the very first time.

ex.en: The movie premieres on Friday.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 금요일에 개봉한다.

easy: The job of being the leader of a country.

ex.en: The presidency is a hard job with many duties.
ex.ko: 대통령직은 할 일이 많은 어려운 직책이다.

easy: To do or feel something because of what happened.

ex.en: The dog reacted to the loud noise by barking.
ex.ko: 개는 큰 소리에 반응해 짖었다.

easy: To mix with another thing and change into something new.

ex.en: Baking soda reacts with vinegar and makes bubbles.
ex.ko: 베이킹 소다는 식초와 반응해 거품을 만든다.

easy: Seeing things as they truly are, not just as you wish.

ex.en: A realistic goal is to read one book each week.
ex.ko: 일주일에 책 한 권 읽기는 현실적인 목표이다.

easy: Looking just like real life.

ex.en: She drew a realistic picture of her cat.
ex.ko: 그녀는 고양이를 실물처럼 사실적으로 그렸다.

easy: To hold something in and not let it go.

ex.en: A sponge retains water.
ex.ko: 스펀지는 물을 머금고 있다.

easy: To keep something so you can use it later.

ex.en: Please retain your ticket until the end of the show.
ex.ko: 공연이 끝날 때까지 표를 보관해 주세요.

easy: Covered with many rocks or stones.

ex.en: We walked up a rocky hill.
ex.ko: 우리는 바위투성이 언덕을 올라갔다.

easy: Bumpy and shaking as you move.

ex.en: The bus ride was rocky on the dirt road.
ex.ko: 비포장도로에서 버스가 덜컹거렸다.

easy: Not steady and likely to wobble.

ex.en: The rocky chair almost made me fall.
ex.ko: 흔들거리는 의자 때문에 넘어질 뻔했다.

easy: A happy feeling when you got what you wanted or finished something.

ex.en: She felt great satisfaction after finishing her puzzle.
ex.ko: 그녀는 퍼즐을 끝내고 큰 만족감을 느꼈다.

easy: A small cut on your skin from something rough.

ex.en: I got a scratch on my knee when I fell.
ex.ko: 넘어져서 무릎에 긁힌 상처가 생겼다.

easy: A thin line on a surface made by something sharp.

ex.en: There is a scratch on my new phone.
ex.ko: 내 새 휴대폰에 긁힌 자국이 있다.

easy: A cool, darker place where the sun does not shine directly.

ex.en: We sat in the shade of a big tree.
ex.ko: 우리는 큰 나무 그늘에 앉았다.

easy: A color that is a little lighter or darker than another color.

ex.en: I painted the wall a light shade of blue.
ex.ko: 나는 벽을 연한 파란색으로 칠했다.

easy: Something that blocks the sun, like a cover over a window.

ex.en: We pulled down the shade to block the sun.
ex.ko: 우리는 햇빛을 막으려고 차양을 내렸다.

easy: The main police officer in an area of a state.

ex.en: The sheriff helped the lost puppy find its home.
ex.ko: 보안관이 길 잃은 강아지가 집을 찾도록 도와주었다.

easy: At a time that is not yet decided.

ex.en: Let's play at the park sometime.
ex.ko: 언제 한번 공원에서 놀자.

easy: Fair and kind, even when you lose.

ex.en: It was sporting of her to clap for the winner.
ex.ko: 그녀가 우승자에게 박수를 쳐 준 것은 정정당당했다.

easy: Having to do with sports.

ex.en: Our school has a big sporting event every spring.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 매년 봄에 큰 운동 경기 행사를 한다.

easy: Only, and nothing else.

ex.en: This room is strictly for students.
ex.ko: 이 방은 오직 학생들만을 위한 곳이다.

easy: In a way that follows the rules very carefully.

ex.en: Running in the hallway is strictly not allowed.
ex.ko: 복도에서 뛰는 것은 엄격히 금지되어 있다.

easy: The light and warmth from the sun.

ex.en: We played outside in the warm sunshine.
ex.ko: 우리는 따뜻한 햇살 속에서 밖에서 놀았다.

easy: The years of life from age 13 to 19.

ex.en: My big brother is in his teens.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 10대이다.

easy: One level in a stack of levels.

ex.en: Our birthday cake has three tiers.
ex.ko: 우리 생일 케이크는 3단이다.

easy: Having to do with singing.

ex.en: She takes vocal lessons to sing better.
ex.ko: 그녀는 노래를 더 잘하려고 성악 수업을 듣는다.

easy: Having to do with making sounds with your voice.

ex.en: Your vocal cords help you talk and sing.
ex.ko: 성대는 말하고 노래하는 것을 도와준다.

easy: Saying what you think in a strong, open way.

ex.en: She is vocal about keeping the park clean.
ex.ko: 그녀는 공원을 깨끗이 하자고 분명하게 의견을 말한다.

easy: To give in and break or give way when pushed hard.

ex.en: The ice yielded under my feet and cracked.
ex.ko: 내 발밑에서 얼음이 갈라지며 무너졌다.

easy: Being allowed to go in.

ex.en: Admission to the zoo is free for kids under five.
ex.ko: 5세 미만 어린이는 동물원 입장이 무료이다.

easy: Saying that something is true, even if it is hard to say.

ex.en: Her admission that she ate the cookie surprised us.
ex.ko: 그녀가 쿠키를 먹었다고 인정해서 우리는 놀랐다.

easy: The money you pay to get in.

ex.en: The admission for the movie is eight dollars.
ex.ko: 그 영화의 입장료는 8달러이다.

easy: Thin salty slices of pig meat that are fried.

ex.en: I love the smell of bacon in the morning.
ex.ko: 나는 아침에 나는 베이컨 냄새가 좋다.

easy: Something that blocks the way.

ex.en: The fence is a barrier that keeps the dog in the yard.
ex.ko: 울타리는 개를 마당에 가두는 장벽이다.

easy: Something that makes it hard to do what you want.

ex.en: Not speaking English was a barrier for the new student.
ex.ko: 영어를 못하는 것이 전학생에게는 장애물이었다.

easy: Thinking that something is true.

ex.en: Believing in yourself helps you try new things.
ex.ko: 자신을 믿으면 새로운 일에 도전하는 데 도움이 된다.

easy: To break open suddenly.

ex.en: The balloon burst with a loud pop.
ex.ko: 풍선이 펑 소리를 내며 터졌다.

easy: Throwing a fishing line far out into the water.

ex.en: Casting the line takes practice.
ex.ko: 낚싯줄을 던지는 데는 연습이 필요하다.

easy: Cows and bulls that are raised on farms.

ex.en: The cattle ate grass in the big field.
ex.ko: 소들은 넓은 들판에서 풀을 먹었다.

easy: A very small amount of liquid, one thousandth of a liter.

ex.en: The nurse gave me five cc of medicine.
ex.ko: 간호사 선생님이 약 5cc를 주셨다.

easy: A room at school where students learn.

ex.en: Our classroom has a big window.
ex.ko: 우리 교실에는 큰 창문이 있다.

easy: Easy to use and good for what you need.

ex.en: The store near my house is convenient.
ex.ko: 우리 집 근처 가게는 편리하다.

easy: People who are old.

ex.en: Our class sang songs for the elderly.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 어르신들께 노래를 불러 드렸다.

easy: To get rid of something completely.

ex.en: Our school will eliminate plastic cups.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 플라스틱 컵을 없앨 것이다.

easy: Making you feel shy or silly in front of others.

ex.en: Tripping in front of the whole class was embarrassing.
ex.ko: 반 친구들 앞에서 넘어진 것은 창피했다.

easy: A person who grows crops or raises animals on a farm.

ex.en: The farmer gets up early to feed the cows.
ex.ko: 농부는 소에게 먹이를 주려고 일찍 일어난다.

easy: To tell someone something they did not know.

ex.en: The teacher informed us about the field trip.
ex.ko: 선생님이 우리에게 현장 학습에 대해 알려 주셨다.

easy: A very tiny bit of matter that has a positive or negative electric charge.

ex.en: Salt in water breaks into ions.
ex.ko: 소금은 물에 녹으면 이온으로 나뉜다.

easy: Being the same as something else.

ex.en: Her drawing is on a par with a real artist's.
ex.ko: 그녀의 그림은 진짜 화가의 그림과 맞먹는다.

easy: A show you can listen to on a phone or computer.

ex.en: I listen to a science podcast on the bus.
ex.ko: 나는 버스에서 과학 팟캐스트를 듣는다.

easy: A collection of someone's best work to show to others.

ex.en: She put her best drawings in her art portfolio.
ex.ko: 그녀는 가장 잘 그린 그림들을 미술 포트폴리오에 넣었다.

easy: How much good work a person or thing can do.

ex.en: Sleeping well raises your productivity at school.
ex.ko: 잘 자면 학교에서의 생산성이 높아진다.

easy: A set of rules to follow to be safe.

ex.en: Follow the safety protocol during the fire drill.
ex.ko: 소방 훈련 때는 안전 수칙을 따라야 한다.

easy: Without loud sounds.

ex.en: She spoke quietly so the baby would sleep.
ex.ko: 그녀는 아기가 자도록 조용히 말했다.

easy: A cold dish of mixed vegetables, often with leafy greens.

ex.en: I ate a salad with tomatoes and cucumbers.
ex.ko: 나는 토마토와 오이가 들어간 샐러드를 먹었다.

easy: Money given to a student to help pay for school.

ex.en: My cousin won a scholarship to college.
ex.ko: 내 사촌은 대학 장학금을 받았다.

easy: Showing a happy look with a smile.

ex.en: The smiling girl waved at me.
ex.ko: 웃고 있는 여자아이가 나에게 손을 흔들었다.

easy: A hot liquid food made with vegetables, meat, or noodles.

ex.en: I had hot chicken soup when I was sick.
ex.ko: 아플 때 따뜻한 닭고기 수프를 먹었다.

easy: A pointed stick pushed into the ground to mark a spot.

ex.en: Dad drove a stake into the ground to mark the garden corner.
ex.ko: 아빠는 정원 모퉁이를 표시하려고 땅에 말뚝을 박았다.

easy: A worried, tense feeling from a hard problem.

ex.en: The strain of the big test made him feel nervous.
ex.ko: 큰 시험의 부담 때문에 그는 긴장했다.

easy: Thought to be true, but not sure.

ex.en: The suspected cause of the leak was a broken pipe.
ex.ko: 물이 새는 원인으로 의심되는 것은 고장 난 파이프였다.

easy: The tools and equipment you use for fishing.

ex.en: Dad packed his fishing tackle in a box.
ex.ko: 아빠는 낚시 도구를 상자에 챙겼다.

easy: Needing to be done right away.

ex.en: This is urgent, so please answer right now.
ex.ko: 급한 일이니까 지금 바로 답해 주세요.

easy: Straight up and down.

ex.en: The flagpole stands in a vertical line.
ex.ko: 깃대는 수직으로 서 있다.
